CMAKE_MINIMUM_REQUIRED(VERSION 3.14)
PROJECT(ctest2 C)
SET(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE ON)
SET(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug")
SET(CMAKE_C_COMPILER "/usr/bin/cc")
SET(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "")
SET(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "-O3 ")
SET(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
SET(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELWITHDEBUGINFO "")
SET(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_MINSIZE "")
ADD_EXECUTABLE(ctest2 ctest2.c)
FIND_LIBRARY(FLIB flib /home/yuhangdai/OpenModelica/OMEdit/OMCompiler/3rdParty/sundials-5.4.0/FortranTest)
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(ctest2 ${FLIB})
